protocol: All selected unique plate targets. Crop exact/CER includes empty predictions. Full-image target match selects highest IoU>=0.5 without using text. No full-scene precision claim. 5 crop warmups per layout/engine and 1 detector warmup; rotating engine order. CPU ONNX2 threads, detector640/conf0.35/max20; timing excludes file IO/HTTP/storage, pipeline timing includes detector/OCR/quality.
limitations: Filename labels not independently human audited. Upstream OCR pretraining overlap unknown. No capture/session metadata; split is by plate and exact pixels, not proof of camera-independent generalization. Dataset redistribution license unconfirmed; images remain local. Partially annotated scenes; extra detections are not scored as false positives. Wilson/McNemar assume independent target outcomes; capture dependencies are not fully modeled.
